snippet.title: Might and Magic Fates - Official Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Might and Magic Fates is an upcoming original free-to-play trading card game set in the legendary Might and Magic universe, developed by Ubisoft in collaboration with Immutable. Coming to mobile.

Learn more at www.MightAndMagicFates.com

Forge your deck, master unique mechanics, and battle for glory in a world where timelines collide and mythical heroes and creatures from every era clash. With deep strategy, rich lore, and hundreds of iconic cards to collect, every card is a choice, every duel, a step toward legend.

Don’t want to miss an update?

- Follow us on X: https://x.com/MightMagicFates

- Join the community on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/HDwuTwpEnE
